title: List item renders the task object instead of its title
summary: app/page.tsx renders the task object ({task as any}) where it used to render {task.title}, so React receives an object child and the title text never reaches the DOM. The cast is only there to keep next build's type check green; the "creating a task..." test still fails at toContainText.

expectedFailure.testTitle: creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter
